Title: Aabbt Kindred / Spell of Life question

Messages.Author: tbz_...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
I was pondering creating an Aabbt / SoL deck.

Clearly the Aabbt wouldn't contest with each other, and (I don't
believe) an individual Aabbt wouldn't contest with an Aabt SoL Mummy,
but would two Aabbt SoL mummies contest with each other?

1.) Yes, they are both now unique Mummy Allies named Aabbt Kindred,
and therefore contest each other
2.) No, each mummy is a unique version of a non-unique vampire, and
therefor don't contest, ie each Mummy is a unique non-unique minion.

My gut feeling is 1 would be true, which makes me a sad panda (and
makes me discard a decklist :P ), but 2 is more twisty-logic, which is
fun.

please advise.

Ta
B

tbz_...@hotmail.com wrote:
> I was pondering creating an Aabbt / SoL deck.

I think the trick you want is for the Aabbt to bring Nefertiti into
play as a mummy. Since SoL makes her keep her name, she allows the
Aabbt to take (D) actions.
Slow, but cheap.
